name: Parag Milk Foods Ltd
title: Parag Milk Foods Ltd - 539889 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 core volumes fell 3% (branded -5%) on lapped institutional and export sales; gross margin rose to 28% but EBITDA margin slipped to ~8.1%, with no capacity discipline signal and inventory up ~INR150 crore on rate variance.

triggers.label: Core volume -3% in Q4
triggers.quote: in core categories itself, there is a volume decline of 3%

triggers.label: Gross margin 26.7% → 28% YoY
triggers.quote: the percentage of gross margin last year was 26.7%, which is now 28% for Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Inventory up ~INR150 cr on rates
triggers.quote: the inventory has increased by almost INR150-odd crores and purely on account of rate variance

triggers.label: No FY27 volume guidance; aspires double-digit
triggers.quote: we don't typically give a yearly guidance

guidance.quote: we are looking at a double -digit volume growth for core categories
we will definitely give a guidance of INR60 crores to INR70 crores of capex
we see this business contributing to around 20% to 25% of the overall revenues
we aspire for in the coming years we have to move to double digit

red_flags.label: Core volume decline and inventory rise
red_flags.quote: there is a volume decline of 5% almost for the quarter 4 as an overall branded business

red_flags.label: EBITDA margin down YoY despite gross margin gain
red_flags.quote: we have dipped from 8.5% to almost 8.1%

evasions.quote: I would not like to comment on specific guidance for core categories

evasions.topic: New age FY29 INR1,000 crore target
evasions.quote: FY29, saying precise INR1000 crores we are not commenting on that
we do not give a product-wise category-wise margins
